title: Size and position

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Scale and position partner marks according to context so the audience can read ownership and support at the intended viewing distance.
strategic_value: A flexible but clear hierarchy can keep IBM legible without implying equal co-branding.
demonstration: The page combines a partner/IBM alignment study with a physical-distance example and a laptop example, beside contextual guidance.
practical_value: Judge relative visual prominence and viewing context instead of copying one fixed logo size or position.

content_islands.name: Context guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation of size, format and communication ownership at left.

content_islands.name: Size relationship
content_islands.spec: Show the large green partner mark and smaller IBM mark with horizontal guide lines in the upper area.

content_islands.name: Position studies
content_islands.spec: Compare a physical display with viewer silhouette and a laptop layout below, retaining the note that examples are not exhaustive.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source connects relative size with avoiding the impression of co-branding and connects placement to how formats are consumed.
reference_purposes.Application: The examples compare screen and physical settings and explain sizing by the formal qualities of the partner logo.
reference_purposes.Constraint: IBM must be smaller than the partner logo; sizing and positions are not restricted to the suggested examples.

ingredient.name: Relative partner-logo scale
ingredient.role: Show IBM as support rather than the communication owner.
ingredient.application: Size IBM smaller than the partner mark while considering the partner mark’s visual qualities and the format’s viewing conditions.
ingredient.scope: Strategic-partner communications. The page supplies studies, not a numerical logo-size ratio or exhaustive placement template.
